description: One line of hoard's provenance manifest, version 1: a JSON object recording where a page came from and the hash it had when it arrived. The manifest is append-only, and the latest line for a dest is the one that counts. dest is vault-relative by convention. A retire line is a tombstone for a dest that was renamed or discarded, naming its successor if any; a rename line pins a page that was authored in the vault and then moved. Lines may carry keys this schema does not name.
